# Deep-learning generalization corpus: sources

Each file holds one arXiv paper, fetched from arXiv on 2026-11-21. Papers released under CC BY 4.0 or CC BY-SA 4.0 contribute body text (pypdf extraction before the references, capped, NFKC-normalized). All other papers contribute only their abstract, which arXiv releases as CC0 1.0 metadata (https://info.arxiv.org/help/license/index.html). Copyright in each paper remains with its authors; see the URL for attribution.
